feed.$description: Feed (the APG feed pattern under activity streams, audit logs and notification inboxes). Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

card-padding.$description: Padding of a card-variant article. One step above the density cell padding so a card keeps its breathing room at every density: 16px by default and comfortable, 10px compact.

row-padding-y.$description: Block padding of a list-variant article. List rows are table-like, so they follow the table cell rhythm exactly.

row-padding-x.$description: Inline padding of a list-variant article. Constant across densities: density compresses rhythm, not the reading edge.
